title: Task spec
description: Input contract for tasks/inbox/<task-id>/spec.json. Written by bot.py (Telegram trigger), by windmill/flows/pipeline-trigger.yaml (cron trigger), or dropped directly by an operator or script (manual/scripted trigger). Consumed by task-dispatcher daemon, which moves the folder to tasks/active/ and writes state.json + task.md.

trigger.description: Where the task originated. 'telegram' = submitted via the Telegram bot (requires telegram_thread). 'windmill' = submitted by a Windmill cron flow (telegram_thread optional). 'manual' = dropped directly into tasks/inbox/ by an operator or script (telegram_thread optional; supply it to opt into status threading).

user.description: Telegram username (e.g. 'your-telegram-handle') or 'windmill-cron'. Used for routing approval prompts back to the right Telegram thread.

prompt.description: Free-text task description from the user. The BA stage consumes this verbatim.

target_repo.description: Absolute filesystem path to the target repo working tree (e.g. '/home/<user>/projects/<target-repo>') OR a git remote URL the dispatcher will clone into a worktree.

schedule.description: Optional cron expression if this task originated from a Windmill schedule. Echoed into state.json for audit; the dispatcher does not parse it.

task_id.description: Optional. If omitted, the dispatcher allocates 'TASK-<N>' where N is the next sequential id. If supplied, must match TASK-<digits> or a kebab-case slug.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the spec was written. The dispatcher fills this if absent.

cost_cap_usd.description: Hard ceiling on total API spend for this task. When exceeded, the dispatcher stops the auto-loop, moves the folder to awaiting-input/, and asks the user via Telegram whether to continue.

iteration_cap.description: Max number of Dev->Test->Sec->Reviewer iterations before escalation. Combined with cost_cap_usd as the watchdog upper bound.

model_routing.description: Per-stage backend selection. Defaults follow PHASE-5-DESIGN §3: BA and Architect on Opus (anthropic), the rest on DeepSeek. GLM-5.1 (z.ai) is available as third fallback; the rate-limit recovery menu in bot.py exposes switch buttons across all three. Override per-task if the prompt warrants a different mix. A value may name a key profile after a colon ("deepseek:alt"), selecting which key of that provider pays for the stage — see bot/providers.json and the ADR provider-key-profiles (T15). Without a registry the suffix resolves to the global key, i.e. today's behavior.

provider_profile.description: Which named key profile pays for each provider on this task (T15). Keyed by backend: {"deepseek": "alt"} makes every deepseek stage authenticate with the profile named 'alt' in bot/providers.json. Written by the bot from the operator's /backend selection; a per-stage suffix in model_routing ("deepseek:alt") overrides it. Ignored when the host has no registry.

telegram_thread.description: Telegram chat id + message id of the original request. Used to thread status updates back to the right conversation. Required when trigger=telegram (conditional enforced by allOf/if/then below). Optional for trigger=windmill and trigger=manual — supply it to opt into status threading; omit or set null to skip Telegram notifications for this task.
